title: tools/interop/chat does not resolve: icu_collections conflict via jmap-metadata-server
description: Found during mimid-1vul.10 (2026-11-20). On main 26720d5 as well, 'cargo check --offline' in tools/interop/chat fails before compiling: icu_casemap 2.2.0 (required by jmap-metadata-server at crate-jmap e4d206ea, through mimid-server) wants icu_collections ~2.2.0, but the tool's Cargo.lock pins icu_collections 2.3.0 via icu_normalizer 2.3.0. Not caused by mimid-1vul.10; tools/interop/seed checks, but cargo refreshes its stale Cargo.lock on the way (not committed).
